0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-7, 11th in the East, 4 games back in the Central) are on the road against the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West, 2.5 games back in the Southwest), with Indiana on a one-game losing streak and Dallas on a one-game winning streak. The Pacers are 0-5 at home and 3-2 on the road, while the Mavericks are 3-2 at home and 2-2 on the road. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (out, knee), Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery), Tyrese Haliburton (out, hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell (day-to-day, hamstring strain, a gametime decision), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation). The Pacers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 121-105 loss in Indianapolis on October 23, and they also lost both meetings in 2025-26.
